subject: Decision Making
title: Decision Trees and Flowcharts
description: A short lesson to help you apply Decision Trees and Flowcharts.

hook.text: Decision trees map every option, outcome, and probability on a single diagram. See the whole choice at once.

buildup.text: Each branch splits at a decision point or a chance event. Multiply probabilities, compare expected values.

discovery.text: Hospitals use decision trees for diagnosis. Each symptom narrows the branches until a treatment emerges.

twist.text: Trees get unwieldy fast. A decision with 5 steps and 3 options each creates 243 branches. Humans cannot hold that.

climax.text: Decision trees work best for structured, repeatable choices. For messy, one-time decisions, intuition still leads.

punchline.text: Map every branch, see every outcome. Trees tame structured choices.

quiz.question: When do decision trees work best?
options: For structured, repeatable choices with clear options
